lines: The guns of Verdel Ridge fired all night. On the Hegemony.
But the Hegemony fired back. One rifleman saw a movement across the wire.
One shot. The Concord sapper never got up.
Forty-five men hit by morning. Twenty-seven Hegemony, eighteen Concord.
Six of them fell. Five Hegemony. Their families sent the next in line.
Both hospitals are full. Every bed is taken.
Nine Hegemony wounded wait on stretchers, in the mud.
And a new race has begun. Hill 304.
Hegemony seventy-four. Concord forty-eight. First to one hundred takes the hill.
Tonight the guns fire again. Two more nights of shelling for the Hegemony.
New at the front: a letter from home.
Open your soldier's card and send one. It keeps your soldier fifteen percent safer for one night. Seventy-four letters are already on the way.
Yesterday, 104 new soldiers came up the line. 65 Hegemony, 39 Concord.
